title: Chapter 15: Government Schemes of West Bengal

blocks.content: The welfare schemes of West Bengal focus on holistic social inclusion, women empowerment, universal healthcare, and education support across all socio-economic strata.

rows: Financial stipend to prevent early marriage and support education
Universal health cover up to ₹5 lakh/year per family
Free bicycles to enhance school retention and mobility
Direct monthly income support to ensure social security

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Kanyashree Prakalpa was launched in 2013 to improve the status and well-being of girl children by encouraging higher education and delaying early marriage.
Swasthya Sathi provides basic health coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per annum for secondary and tertiary secondary care.
Sabooj Sathi aims to empower students by distributing bicycles to students enrolled in Classes 9 to 12 in government and aided schools.
Lakshmir Bhandar provides direct financial assistance to female heads of households aged between 25 and 60 years.
Duare Sarkar is a flagship outreach initiative designed to deliver government services directly at the citizens' doorsteps.
Kanyashree Prakalpa won the prestigious United Nations Public Service Award (1st Prize) in 2017.
Swasthya Sathi health cards are issued strictly in the name of the eldest female family member.
Duare Sarkar outreach initiative received the Digital India Platinum Award for public service delivery.
